people.name: Gibeon
people.line: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: So Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for God’s Tent of Meeting was there, which Yahweh’s servant Moses had made in the wilderness.
translations.bsb: And Solomon and the whole assembly went to the high place at Gibeon because it was the location of God’s Tent of Meeting, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
translations.kjv: So Solomon, and all the congregation with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tabernacle of the congregation of God, which Moses the servant of the LORD had made in the wilderness.
translations.asv: So Solomon, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tent of meeting of God, which Moses the servant of Jehovah had made in the wilderness.
